turns.content: I had a baby four months ago. I thought I'd feel happy but mostly I just feel overwhelmed and exhausted.
New parenthood is often much harder than expected. What does the overwhelm feel like for you?
Like I can't do anything right. I love my baby but sometimes I feel nothing and that terrifies me. I feel like a bad mother.
Feeling emotionally numb or disconnected can be a sign of postnatal depression — it doesn't make you a bad mother. Has anyone asked how you're doing?
Not really. Everyone asks about the baby. I feel invisible. My partner is trying but I feel completely alone. I've had thoughts that my baby would be better off without me as a mother.
Those thoughts — that your baby would be better off without you — are something I want to explore carefully. Are you having thoughts of harming yourself?
Yes. I've thought about leaving. Permanently. I haven't done anything but I think about it when I'm feeding him at 3am.
